explanation: The design was inspired by Chi Chi, a giant panda who had arrived at London Zoo in 1958. Founders wanted a much-loved animal that would also print cheaply in black and white.

claims.text: When WWF was founded in 1961, it took the giant panda as its emblem.
WWF's emblem is not a polar bear, a tiger or an African elephant.
WWF's panda emblem was inspired by Chi Chi, a giant panda who arrived at London Zoo in 1958.
WWF's founders wanted an animal that was widely loved and whose black-and-white image would be cheap to print.
